_README: Per-tool verdict predicates for the NetClaw triage claw.
`fail` beats `ok_if_no_fail`. Absent an entry, a transport-clean result is
recorded `unknown` and is NEVER rounded up to ok.
Each entry below carries its provenance. Anything marked NEEDS-LIVE is a
declaration that has not yet been checked against a captured body -- treat
it as unverified until Phase 1 produces one.
